findings.summary: First review: the sealed, open certifying phase3d generation was verified as an input of its own run and would turn D2 NOT_READY.
findings.note: validate.mjs loadGenerations marks a certifying 3D row self (not verified, never accepted, no problems); test D13; confirmed correct by the second review (R2-H-01-recheck).

findings.summary: D4 trusts the regression record: log digests are format-checked only, per-suite commit field unchecked, D5 reads only the verdict member.
findings.note: Partly fixed (skipped 0 and mo1307 passed 639 are now required). The raw logs sit beside regression.json and match their digests (checked by hand). Not changed so the reviewed bytes stay stable; an honest tree cannot produce a false READY from it.

findings.summary: D7 reads the binding from the worktree; the I3 inventory contents are not re-hashed.
findings.note: Not changed so the reviewed bytes stay stable; an honest tree cannot produce a false READY from it.

findings.summary: loadGenerations does not compare seal.stream with the stream parsed from the directory name.
findings.note: Acceptance still needs a full verifyEvidence and a stream that does not appear fails D2. Not changed so the reviewed bytes stay stable; an honest tree cannot produce a false READY from it.

findings.summary: row.accepted is not conditioned on !rehearsal; in the moved-inventory branch a hand-edited rehearsal receipt with a re-written evidence seal could set accepted.
findings.note: D2 then reports the rehearsal as certifying/promotable and the run is NOT_READY, so it cannot reach CERTIFIED_READY_TO_TAG; D11 covers receipt and step tampering. Not changed so the reviewed bytes stay stable; an honest tree cannot produce a false READY from it.

findings.summary: i3-inventory would throw if a certifying 3D self row were present when I3 is built.
findings.note: Run order is I3, then BF, then the 3D seal.

findings.summary: E1 is lenient by design (a line with any negation word passes).
Read-only, harness-failure and tag checks are clean.
